name: kid
$note: A cheeky kid sidekick (male): a big head on a short body (tune), big round eyes with large irises and a bright catchlight, a button nose, messy hair and a beaming open smile. Shows the graphic face words for the eyes (a round fissure, a light lid) and a ring sheen on the hair in place of the fringe streak the male base wears, under its own key direction (toon.light).
